problem: Define a scale-invariant operational meaning of same temporal level without using returns, PnL, 2026, or Development support as a selection objective.

scale_coordinate.name: log2_duration
scale_coordinate.rationale: A dyadic lattice is multiplicatively self-similar and does not privilege an absolute bar duration. Nearest-level cells in log2 duration have half-octave boundaries.

same_level_rule.boundary_note: A ratio of two positive integer bar durations cannot equal irrational sqrt(2) exactly, so <= versus < does not create an integer-duration tie.

next_gate: V0800-D may now be preregistered using only strict shared-anchor pairs, confirmation-time knowledge, rho=sqrt(2), and the already-frozen tau/kappa candidate families. Execution remains blocked until that D protocol is separately reviewed and merged.
